# Blogify

> Curated technical articles and architecture specifications generated directly from codebase and documentation.

## Available Guides

- [Blogify: A Blog Generator for Java-Based Applications](index.html): How we eliminated runtime dependencies and documentation drift by compiling story-first technical blogs directly from code and markdown. (Version: 0.2.0)
- [Idempotent Order Processing Under Extreme Network Latency](idempotent-order-processing.html): How we achieved zero duplicate transactions during 500ms network timeouts using deterministic hash keys. (Version: v1.2.0)
- [Resilient Payment Gateway with Adaptive Circuit Breakers](resilient-payment-gateway.html): Designing a self-healing payment routing mesh that degrades gracefully during downstream PSP outages. (Version: v2.0.0)
- [Synchronous Direct Billing Engine (Legacy Architecture)](legacy-synchronous-billing.html): Original monolithic synchronous payment processing engine. Kept for historical reference. (Version: v0.8.0) [Status: RETIRED]
- [Designing an Idempotent Order Processing Pipeline](designing-idempotent-order-processing.html): A deep dive into building fault-tolerant and idempotent order workflows in modern Java backend systems. (Version: v1.2.0)
- [Resilient Payment Gateway Integration Patterns](resilient-payment-gateway-integration.html): Techniques for integrating external payment APIs with circuit breakers and fallback handlers.

## Architectural Takeaways

### Blogify: A Blog Generator for Java-Based Applications
- Co-locate architecture blogs with the codebase in version control to eliminate documentation drift.
- Keep production lean: technical blogs should generate at compile time with zero runtime dependencies.
- AI discoverability via llms.txt ensures that modern LLMs index concise, token-efficient architecture context.
- Publishing should be frictionless: an on-demand task pushes directly to GitHub Pages without complex CI actions.

### Idempotent Order Processing Under Extreme Network Latency
- Never rely on the client's clock for idempotency windows; compute hash boundaries from canonical business data.
- Return identical HTTP 200 responses for duplicate invocations to make retries completely transparent.
- Anchor your blog documentation directly to immutable git commit snapshots so readers never face drift.

### Resilient Payment Gateway with Adaptive Circuit Breakers
- Fail fast: a 50ms fast-fail error or fallback is infinitely better than hanging client connections for 30s.
- Always test half-open probe states under synthetic Canary traffic before resetting primary traffic.
- Store fallback transactions in an asynchronous reconciliation queue to verify settlement integrity.

### Synchronous Direct Billing Engine (Legacy Architecture)
- Synchronous payment processing does not scale to high-concurrency e-commerce workloads.
- Monolithic single-gateway integrations create critical business single points of failure.

### Designing an Idempotent Order Processing Pipeline
- Compute idempotency hashes from business state, never trusting client timestamps alone.
- Transparently return the cached original 200 OK receipt upon duplicate retry requests.
